profile.headline: Software Engineer III at Walmart
profile.summary: I can summarize myself with one saying, if you need luck you're doing something wrong. I believe in hard work, dedication and self improvement.

positions.title: Broadcaster
positions.description:
- Online community management of over 1,500 people across multiple platforms
- Online sales and marketing for a variety of companies
- Ability to self-manage and self-motivate for long and often over time hours
- Network and communicate with other broadcasters to organize online public events
- Ability to think outside of the box and solve problems that often times are unique and an equally unique solution
- Ability to self-teach and learn on the fly while still performing at peak capacity
- Work with and manage relations with other companies or individuals

positions.title: Technology Sales Representative
positions.description:
- In-store and phone sales
- Fluency with laptop and desktop specifications 
- Ability to compare and contrast various brands of computer and laptop models to meet customer needs
- Conduct presentations and demos for individuals or groups 
- Collaborate as a team to serve customers and make sales 
- Stock, label and secure merchandise based on company policy
- Apply Apple Product Professional ASTO and SEED program expertise to effectively make sales
- Collaborate with Dell and Apple campus representatives to coordinate training and events in store
- Supervise over technology transactions
- Assist with training new sales associates
- Track and record sales in database
- Put in charge of creating a new training program for new and old employees

positions.title: Ride Attendant
positions.description:
- Operated rides for children, teens and adults
- Supervision of customers on rides and responsible for executing safety protocols and standards to assure customers adhere to safety guidelines
- Educated customers on safety protocols through tailored speeches meant to grab attention and entertain 
- Customer service skills for all age groups
- Effectively handle customers from a diverse background
- Clean, organize and maintain all attractions 
- Effectively manage large team to execute and complete tasks for closing duties
